title: session-load's live mode classes kbtail and a bare kbmon.py as other when ps shows the interpreter as Python
goal: bench_load.live_class matches the interpreter name without regard to case, so a framework or Homebrew Python (.../Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python) running kbtail.py or kbmon.py gets the kbtail and kbmon classes

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bench_load as b; P = "/opt/homebrew/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python"; got = [b.live_class(P + " _tools/kbtail.py --follow", b.HOME), b.live_class(P + " _tools/kbmon.py", b.HOME)]; print(got); sys.exit(0 if got == ["kbtail", "kbmon"] else 1)

notes: Review gap 5 of SP-wv3ob5vy: bench_load.py:724 re.fullmatch(r'python[\d.]*', words[0]) is case-sensitive. Premise: the bug's repro fails on the base (origin/main at the planning commit, 2026-11-09); precheck ran it through the landing's check runner. Sprint order: items that share one file are chained with depends_on.
